agency.name: Department of Behavioral Healthcare, Developmental Disabilities and Hospitals (BHDDH)

narrAffiliate.name: Rhode Island Communities for Addiction Recovery Efforts (RICARES)

narrNote: RICARES appears on NARR's official affiliate list; it is Rhode Island's NARR affiliate and also serves as the state's recovery community organization, publishing the list of NARR-certified recovery houses in RI.
notes: Agency identity from SAMHSA's SSA directory, which lists the agency as the 'Division of Behavioral Healthcare, Developmental Disabilities & Hospitals'; the department's own site (bhddh.ri.gov) was fetched and verified — it is recorded here under its current department name, Department of Behavioral Healthcare, Developmental Disabilities and Hospitals. No general agency phone was captured from the fetched page, so agency.phone is null. BH Link is Rhode Island's 24/7 behavioral-health triage center and hotline (975 Waterman Ave, East Providence), confirmed on the RI Department of Health's substance use page and by Rhode Island College and Blue Cross Blue Shield of Rhode Island; its own site's direct fetch was rate-limited (HTTP 429) during this run. Anchor Recovery Community Centers are a peer-run program of The Providence Center; a standalone Anchor domain was not confirmed as current, so the live official Providence Center page is used. Stay Covered Rhode Island (the state's .ri.gov Medicaid benefits site) lists residential treatment for substance use disorders among covered behavioral-health services. 211ri.org is cited by the Providence Journal and the RI Office of Healthy Aging guide as United Way of Rhode Island's 211 website. countyDirectory is null: Rhode Island has no county governments. BACKFILL 2026-10-22: both outstanding RI flags closed by direct browser fetch — bhlink.org verified live (BH Link, operated through Horizon Healthcare Partners; Rhode Island's 24/7 crisis receiving and stabilization center, 975 Waterman Ave, East Providence; 401-414-5465), and 211ri.org verified live for real visitors, serving United Way of Rhode Island's full 211 page; a scripted curl receives a 404 from the site's bot-wall, so the two11 URL is kept unchanged.
